label: uxuA
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the uxuA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor uxuA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 3,803 to 3,882 from dnaA. Read in 533 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying uxuA once); 42,640 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 82% of genes, 0.77 bits on average (perplexity 2.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 19,202 calls, named 95%, 0.23 bits; shell 21,893 calls, named 74%, 1.09 bits; cloud 1,545 calls, named 19%, 3.06 bits. Outside an RGP 21,860 calls, named 93%, 0.29 bits; inside an RGP 20,780 calls, named 70%, 1.29 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 46 fork, 33 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.29 against 0.29 bits) and names fewer genes (70% against 93%); 20,780 of the 42,640 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 14 ("HNH endonuclease", a fork column) 2.90 bits, RGP 84%; column 15 (fecR, a fork column) 2.28 bits, RGP 83%; column 16 (fecA, a fork column) 2.25 bits, RGP 81%. The 34 columns (columns 1-34) where most calls are in an RGP: named 75%, 1.11 bits on average; the other 46 columns: named 87%, 0.53 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 99%, 0.04 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 81%, 0.78 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 14, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 2%. Genes: uxuA. named 99%; 0.04 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: share 4-88%, 43 P, 36 S, RGP 21-94%. named 36-93% (mean 81%), fewest named at column 7, named 36%; most hesitant at column 14, 2.90 bits.
